_readme: Reference for every coded/flag field used in the CMD approval payload (see tests/payloads.json for full examples). Values here must stay in sync with the enum maps at the top of cmdApprovalHelpers.php — if that file changes, update this file too.

data.rentalPayment.gstApplicable.description: Whether GST applies to this bill's rent.

values.0: No - GST does not apply to this bill
values.1: Yes - GST applies; rentalPayment.gstAmount, gstNumber and gstInvoiceUrl become required

data.rentalPayment.gstInvoiceUrl.description: Not a coded flag, but a required field whenever gstApplicable = 1 - the live URL of the GST invoice PDF. Leave empty only when gstApplicable = 0.

values.\"\" (empty string): No invoice attached - only valid when gstApplicable = 0
values.\"https://...\": Live URL to the GST invoice PDF - attached to the CMD approval mail

data.rentalPayment.paymentFrequency.description: How often rent is billed for this site.

data.appraisal.applicable.description: Whether a rent appraisal (revision) applies to this bill. Can be omitted entirely when there is no appraisal at all - an empty/missing appraisal object is treated the same as 0.

values.0: No - no appraisal for this bill
values.1: Yes - appraisal applies; see appraisal.type below

data.appraisal.type.description: How the appraisal amount is calculated. Only read when appraisal.applicable = 1.

values.1: Percentage - appraisal.percentage is a % of base rent, appraisal.appraisalAmount is the resulting ₹ amount
values.2: Fixed Amount - appraisal.fixedAmount / appraisal.appraisalAmount is a flat ₹ figure

data.appraisal.includedInCurrentRent.description: Whether the appraisal amount has ALREADY been folded into rentalPayment.totalRentalAmount by the backend (e.g. rent was revised last cycle). Prevents double-counting the appraisal on top of the base rent.

values.0: No - appraisal.appraisalAmount is a NEW add-on and gets added on top of the base rent in the email
values.1: Yes - base rent already reflects the appraisal; email shows 'Appraisal already included in current rent' instead of adding it again

data.appraisal.frequency.description: How often the appraisal (rent revision) recurs.

data.landOwners[].onlineMode.description: Mode used for the ONLINE portion of payment. Only relevant when paymentCategory is 2 (Online) or 3 (Cash + Online); leave 0/empty for cash-only owners (shown as '-' in the email).

data.landOwners[].gstHold.description: Whether GST is being WITHHELD from this remittance (money stays with the company for now). Does NOT reduce the CMD-approved amount - the full rent+GST is still shown as payable, just flagged 'ON HOLD'. Only meaningful for a single landlord (GST is never payable across multiple landlords).

values.0: No - GST is being remitted normally
values.1: Yes - GST amount is on hold; email shows the GST row struck-through with an 'ON HOLD' badge

data.landOwners[].tdsHold.description: Whether this owner's TDS deduction is being held back rather than deducted now. Independent of whether TDS actually applies (see the ₹50,000 online-amount rule below) - only shown when TDS is also applicable.

values.0: No - TDS is deducted normally when applicable
values.1: Yes - TDS is on hold for this owner; shown struck-through with an 'ON HOLD' badge / listed in the multi-landlord TDS-hold notes

data.billingType.description: How multiple sites under one landlord should be billed. Only relevant when data.sites[] is used (multi-site payloads); ignored/defaults to single_bill for legacy single-site payloads.

values.single_bill (or omitted): One consolidated CMD approval email covering all sites in data.sites[]
values.separate_bill: One CMD approval email PER SITE - only actually splits into per-site emails when there is exactly 1 landlord; with multiple landlords it still consolidates into one email

_computed_fields_not_sent_by_caller._note: These are NOT input flags - they are computed by cmdApprovalHelpers.php from the raw numbers above and only appear in the OUTGOING email payload for reference. You do not set these yourself.
_computed_fields_not_sent_by_caller.is_tds_applicable / tds_applicable: TDS applies automatically once a landlord's ONLINE amount (data.landOwners[].onlineAmount) is >= 50000, at tdsPercentage% - this is a computed rule, there is no raw 'tdsApplicable' input flag to set.
_computed_fields_not_sent_by_caller.is_gst_applicable / gst_applicable: True only when gstApplicable = 1 AND there is exactly 1 landlord (GST is never shown/payable for multiple landlords) AND the computed GST amount is > 0.
_computed_fields_not_sent_by_caller.gst_invoice_attached: True when GST is applicable and rentalPayment.gstInvoiceUrl was provided and successfully fetched.
_computed_fields_not_sent_by_caller.gst_invoice_missing: True when GST is applicable but rentalPayment.gstInvoiceUrl was empty - shown as a red 'Missing' flag in the email since the invoice is mandatory whenever GST applies.
